look_here_first: Start with the cut or lobed leaves and nocturnal yellow flowers. Cutleaf evening primrose is a low annual or short-lived perennial with alternate leaves that range from toothed to deeply cut-lobed, and 4-petaled yellow flowers that open around sunset.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves variable from dentate to distinctly cut-lobed

lookalikes.differences: Unlike O. capillifolia, the leaves are much broader and commonly cut-lobed. Unlike the gaura-like species, flowers are radially symmetric and yellow rather than white/pink and strongly zygomorphic.
